title: Demo showcase
author: ElegantRegister6664
selftext:
Hi everybody ,I'm working on a open world game where you can be an animal ,explore the world and interact with the world around you ,that includes other animal and the vegetation,it's just the start but I have lot of ideas with this project ,this is where is it now ,started 3 days ago .

If anyone interested in contributing Id be so happy ,I want it to be a free game for people to learn more about animals and enjoy the nature .

As for now the current ambient is the savanna with acacia trees and dry grass , I have just started working on the animation layer for the gazelle but it is tedious and would need better workflow to generalize simulation for other animals ,instead of long trials/errors animations  .

https://youtu.be/7LmUEqAlZj4

comments.author: Xinnobun
comments.body:
Pretty cool, like a Safari life. Could go into detail on things animals have to do to survive. Because different animals have different tactics for survival in the brutal world out there. So its kind of like the discovery channel or national geographic, except you're living in it.   
  
Another cool thing you could do is starting off at the very bottom of the animal food chain, like a bug. And if you survive long enough (like outsmarting and escaping a rodent that eats bugs), you get to play that rodent next. And now you freely eat bugs but you've got all sorts of new predators to hide from. Like a jackal, then later you get to play the jackal and face other bigger predators.

replies.author: ElegantRegister6664
replies.body:
Yes bingo ,that's my goal  ,a game where you could live the experience of being in a national geography documentary haha , yes my next goals would be hunger system ,gazelle would need to drink ,eat grass and bugs ,predators would track them by following their feces , there are lions and zebras too but I haven't made animations yet ,my only blockage is token limits ,that's why I'm hoping someone with the same interest could participate with me , btw you nailed perfectly,  the gazelle would live in group and they alert each others on upcoming dangers ,they have great senses .
The project also allows to be different animals ,once you die you will be reincarnated to be one of the remaining gazelles or you get to choose another life in the nearby.
Now gazelle can sense danger and run from you but that's as far as it gets , those few days were few hour a day adjusting  the animation laywr and my weekly token on 20$ subscription all burnt hahha.
